children: Karyopharm Therapeutics submitted an sNDA seeking Accelerated Approval for selinexor with ruxolitinib in myelofibrosis and requested Priority Review.
Submitted supplemental NDA to FDA for Accelerated Approval of XPOVIO (selinexor) + ruxolitinib for myelofibrosis.
Requested Priority Review, which could shorten FDA review to six months if granted.
sNDA is supported in part by Phase 3 SENTRY topline data, including a promising overall survival signal.
Plans to use long-term overall survival from SENTRY to verify clinical benefit to convert accelerated to traditional approval.
